card.name: Words just before a risk or effect
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the' or 'can' right before a risk or adverse-effect term, e.g. 'increase the risk'. Also fires partway through some drug names and 'infusion'.

modes.label: 'the' before risk
modes.description: The word 'the' after verbs like increase or reduce, ahead of 'risk of'.

modes.label: Link word before effect
modes.description: A word such as 'can' or 'these medicines' leading into a stated effect.
modes.example: Combining alcohol with these medicines<< can>> cause nausea and vomiting.

modes.label: Inside drug or term
modes.description: Middle of a drug name or of 'infusion' in a heading.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about mild or resulting effects and away from unrelated word endings.
card.plain: It fires on little words that come just before a stated risk or side effect.
